repeats.name: Olivier
repeats.line: You've been over this ground twice now. Nothing you can prove — the trail is going cold. Digging further just burns daylight.

moots.conveneLine: Desmond has been talking at the fires. Enough voices — tonight they call a moot. Ella answers for what happened to Desmond.
Desmond is back at the fires, and the village doesn't need convincing this time. Ella answers for what happened to Desmond — again.
